# Specimen API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

One item of a specimen set, such as a single slice, section or well.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/specimen/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/stem/specimen/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `specimen` (detail, create, update), `specimens` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `specimen_set` → `projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Uniqueness:** `specimen_set`, `local_identifier` unique together
- **Schema payload:** `type` selects a [Specimen type](/api/schemas/specimen/); send its fields in `details`. `type_schema_version` is set by the server; do not send it.

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `specimen_set` | [`specimenset`](/api/stem/specimenset/) id **[required]**; nestable |
| `local_identifier` | string **[required]**; max 100 characters. Stable identifier for this specimen within its specimen set. |
| `type` | one of the [Specimen types](/api/schemas/specimen/) **[required]** |
| `preparation_conditions` | JSON object **[read-only]** |
| `status` | one of `planned`, `available`, `in_use`, `reserved`, `consumed`, `discarded`, `lost` **[required]**. Current availability status of this specimen. |
| `quality` | one of `excellent`, `good`, `fair`, `poor`, `not_assessed`. Quality assessment for this specimen. |
| `laterality` | one of `left`, `right`, `bilateral`, `not_applicable`. Which side of the brain or body this specimen comes from. |
| `storage_location` | string; max 100 characters; nullable. Current physical storage location, container, or slot. |
| `storage_conditions` | string; max 100 characters; nullable. Current storage conditions, such as temperature and medium. |
| `termination_datetime` | datetime; nullable. When this specimen was consumed, discarded, lost, or otherwise terminated. |
| `order` | number; nullable. Ordering within the specimen set. |
| `source_specimen` | [`specimen`](/api/stem/specimen/) id; nullable; nestable. Specimen this specimen was derived from, if applicable. |
| `notes` | string; nullable. Free-text notes about this specimen. |
| `details` | JSON object |
| `type_schema_version` | string **[set by the server]** |
| `created_at` | datetime **[read-only]**; nullable |
| `updated_at` | datetime **[read-only]** |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/specimen/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('specimen', load_all=True)
records = resp['specimens']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('specimen', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.specimens;
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/specimen/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('specimen', data={"specimen_set": "<specimenset-id>", "local_identifier": "<local_identifier>", "type": "CultureItem", "status": "available", "details": {"...": "see the schema of the selected type"}})
record = resp.json()['specimen']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('specimen_set', '<specimenset-id>', 'local_identifier', '<local_identifier>', 'type', 'CultureItem', 'status', 'available', 'details', struct()), 'specimen');  % struct() stands for the fields of the selected type
record = created.specimen;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/specimen/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('specimen', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['specimen']
```

{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('specimen', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.specimen;
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/specimen/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('specimen', id='<id>', data={"local_identifier": "new value"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'local_identifier', 'new value'), 'specimen', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/specimen/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('specimen', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'specimen');
```
